sources.title: DFlash 2: Keep Drafting Parallel — Inco AI
sources.snippet: DFlash 2 is the successor to our widely deployed parallel drafter: close to 3× the speed of autoregressive decoding, with the same output. Drafters for Qwen3.8-27B and Meta's Muse Glimmer are out today.

sources.title: Qwen3.8 27B DFlash2 - interfaze.ai
sources.snippet: This repository contains the DFlash 2 draft model for Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B. It is not a standalone language model: it runs inside a speculative decoding server and drafts tokens for the target model to verify. The checkpoint is also mirrored at z-lab/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2.
